name: correlation_forms
expr: [rl, pl] = corr(X, Y, 'Tail', 'left'); v1 = rl(1); v2 = pl(1); v3 = pl(2); [rr, pr] = corr(X, Y, 'Tail', 'right'); v4 = pr(1); v5 = pr(2); [~, pne] = corr(X, Y, 'Tail', 'ne'); v6 = pne(1); pl2 = corr(X, Y, 'Tail', 'l'); v7 = pl2(1); RW = corr(X, Y, 'Weights', [1 1 1 1 2]'); v8 = RW(1); v9 = RW(2); [rw, pw] = corr(X, Y, 'Weights', [1 1 1 1 2]'); v10 = double(isnan(pw(1))); W0 = [1 0 1 1 1]'; Ca = corr(X, Y, 'Rows', 'complete', 'Weights', W0); v11 = Ca(1); Cb = corr(X, Y, 'Rows', 'all', 'Weights', W0); v12 = Cb(1); Cp = corr(X, Y, 'Rows', 'pairwise', 'Weights', W0); v13 = Cp(1); [r2, p2m] = corr(X([1 2],:)); v14 = r2(4); v15 = double(isnan(p2m(2))); v16 = p2m(1); [rs, ps] = corr(X, Y, 'Type', 'Spearman'); v17 = rs(2); v18 = ps(1); v19 = ps(2); v20 = ps(4); CX = corr(complex(X, X), Y); v21 = real(CX(1)); v22 = imag(CX(1)); S3 = corr(single(X), Y); v23 = double(strcmp(class(S3), 'single')); ctmp = single(corr(X, Y)); v24 = double(abs(S3(1) - ctmp(1)) < 1e-6); NC = nearcorr(B3); v25 = NC(2); v26 = NC(3); NC2 = nearcorr(B3, 'Method', 'projection', 'Tolerance', 1e-12); v27 = NC2(2); NC3 = nearcorr(single(B3)); v28 = double(strcmp(class(NC3), 'single')); R1 = partialcorr(X); v29 = R1(2); v30 = R1(3); v31 = R1(6); R7 = partialcorr(X, Z, 'Type', 'spearman'); v32 = R7(2); v33 = R7(5); R8 = partialcorr(X, Z, 'Type', 'sp'); v34 = R8(2); R9 = partialcorr(X, Z, 'Rows', 'comp'); v35 = R9(2); v36 = R9(3); R14 = partialcorr(single(X), Z); v37 = double(strcmp(class(R14), 'single')); v38 = double(R14(3)); R15 = partialcorr(X, 'Rows', 'pairwise'); v39 = R15(2); RC1 = partialcorr(X, Y, Z); v40 = RC1(2); v41 = RC1(4); RC2 = partialcorr(X, Y, Z, 'Type', 'Spearman'); v42 = RC2(2); v43 = RC2(4);
comment: Correlation-family argcheck-drain spec 2026-09-19: every NEW branch from the reference-probed contracts (probe71{,b} + probe72). corr one-sided Tail p-values (left/right/'ne' alias/'l' prefix) with |r|=1 handled analytically; Weights (weighted Pearson means, zero-weight row drop in every Rows mode incl. pairwise, weighted p all-NaN); n=2 short-circuit (r ones, p NaN off-diag + 1 diag); Spearman tie-corrected coef + exact midrank-permutation p + AS89 for n>=10; complex rho; single output class (single-precision arithmetic diverges from double-compute-then-cast by O(1e-7) — the single VALUE fingerprints use a 1e-6 closeness guard, the class fingerprints are exact). nearcorr gate + Tolerance/MaxIterations/Method NV (defaults 1e-6/200) + non-PSD repair + single cast. partialcorr combinedXZ/xz/xyz forms, spearman rank-then-residualise, 'sp'/'comp' prefixes, combinedXZ pairwise==complete, single output.
